tagline: A Texas-based full-service financial services firm delivering customized solutions.
hero_kpi_rationale: Key performance indicator for banks, reflecting the core profitability of the financial services sector. TCBI reported a significant 14.1% YoY increase to $1,029 million.

kpis.name: Net Interest Income
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from interest on loans and deposits
kpis.description: Net interest income is a key indicator of a bank's performance. Tracked annually by company analysts, with historical values over the past 5 years.
kpis.signal: Significant increase in net interest income

kpis.name: Net Interest Margin
kpis.explanation: Margin between interest earned and interest paid
kpis.description: Net interest margin is a key indicator of a bank's profitability
kpis.signal: Significant improvement in net interest margin

kpis.name: Return on Average Assets (ROA)
kpis.explanation: Profitability of a bank's average assets
kpis.description: Return on average assets is a key indicator of a bank's performance
kpis.signal: Significant improvement in return on average assets

kpis.name: Non-interest Income
kpis.description: Non-interest income is a key indicator of a bank's diversification
kpis.signal: Dramatic increase in non-interest income, primarily due to absence of securities losses in 2025

kpis.name: Efficiency Ratio
kpis.explanation: Ratio between a bank's costs and revenues
kpis.description: Efficiency ratio is a key indicator of a bank's cost management

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets are a key indicator of a bank's size

kpis.name: Total Deposits
kpis.description: Total deposits are a key indicator of a bank's liquidity and funding base

kpis.name: Total Loans
kpis.description: Total loans are a key indicator of a bank's lending activity

kpis.name: Allowance for Credit Losses
kpis.explanation: Provision for credit losses of the bank
kpis.description: Allowance for credit losses is a key indicator of a bank's risk management
kpis.signal: Moderate increase in allowance for credit losses

risks.title: Credit Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company has a significant loan portfolio of $24.0 billion and substantial exposure to credit risk.

risks.title: Interest Rate Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to fluctuations in interest rates, which affect its net interest income and net interest margin.

risks.title: Market Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to market risks, including fluctuations in equity and bond prices, as evidenced by a $1.9 million loss on available-for-sale securities in 2025.

risks.title: Liquidity Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company maintains an adequate level of liquidity with total deposits of $26.8 billion and non-interest-bearing deposits of $8.2 billion.

risks.title: Regulatory Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to strict regulations as a bank holding company and recently joined the Federal Reserve System in September 2025.
